findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context returns original config, losing schedule_type display conversion
findings.body: The function copies `monitor_environment.monitor.config` into a local `config` variable on line 160 and converts `schedule_type` to its display string (e.g., "crontab" instead of the raw integer choice) on lines 161-162. However, the returned dict on line 168 uses `"config": monitor_environment.monitor.config` — the un-modified original — instead of the local `config` variable. As a result, the `schedule_type` display conversion is silently discarded, and the incident event payload will show the raw integer choice value instead of the human-readable schedule type name. The fix is to change line 168 to `"config": config`.

findings.title: Docstring typo in get_failure_reason
findings.body: The docstring on line 132 contains "humam readible" which should be "human readable".

findings.title: Docstring example for get_failure_reason does not match actual output
findings.body: The docstring on line 136 shows the singular example as `"A failed check-in was detected"`, but the actual `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP` values are `"An error check-in was detected"`, `"A missed check-in was detected"`, and `"A timeout check-in was detected"`. None of the actual outputs match the documented example.
